votes.motion: Approve the Truth in Taxation meeting minutes of August 15, 2023
votes.description: The Council approved the official minutes from the Truth-in-Taxation meeting held on August 15, 2023.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items B1 and B2 (Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant and Jordan River Tree and Debris Removal Grant) to a future Consent Agenda
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing for two grant applications—one for the Police Department from the U.S. Department of Justice and one for the Trails & Natural Lands Division from the Utah Division of Forestry—and referred both to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Zoning Map Amendment and Annexation at approximately 2350/2441 North Rose Park Lane to a future Council meeting
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed annexation and rezoning near Rose Park Lane and deferred any final action to a future meeting, with the project potentially facilitating a mixed-use, multi-family residential development of up to 1,800 units.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 50 of 2023, amending the Fiscal Year 2024 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document for items A-1, D-1 through D-7
votes.description: The Council adopted specific line items in Budget Amendment No. 1 for FY2023-24, including a donation for sports lighting, AFSCME MOU allocations, consolidated fee schedule changes, roadway rescoping, bond fund reallocation, bridge rehabilitation funding, an occupied vehicle mitigation team allocation, and fleet vehicle purchase re-appropriations.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 50 of 2023, approving item A-2: One-time Additional Funding for Fall 2023 Downtown Open Streets Events ($250,000 from General Fund Balance)
votes.description: The Council approved an additional $250,000 from the General Fund Balance to fund fall 2023 Downtown Open Streets events as part of Budget Amendment No. 1 for FY2023-24.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda with the exception of Item G4 (Rezone and Master Plan Amendments at approximately 135, 159, and 163 West Goltz Avenue and 1036 South Jefferson Street), which would be scheduled for a future Council meeting
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates for several ordinances and approving the board appointment of Caitlin Tursic to the Arts Council Board, while deferring the Goltz Avenue/Jefferson Street rezone item to a future meeting.
